# GITEX

> GITEX is a premier global technology trade show and conference platform hosting multiple tech-focused events in Dubai, featuring exhibitor registration, booth booking, and showcases across AI, blockchain, IoT, and emerging technologies.

GITEX operates a portfolio of technology conferences and trade shows centered in Dubai, including GITEX Global (the flagship annual event), specialized summits covering fintech, blockchain, and AR/VR, and industry-specific conferences. The platform connects thousands of international exhibitors with global audiences across multiple technology verticals.

## Key Topics

- GITEX Global 2023
- GITEX Global 2026
- Dubai

## Exhibitor Registration & Booth Booking

- [Exhibit at GITEX GLOBAL 2026 - Dubai](https://mktg.gitex.com/BookAStand2026): Booth booking and exhibitor registration for GITEX GLOBAL 2026 in Dubai.
- [Exhibit at GITEX GLOBAL 2023 - Dubai](https://mktg.gitex.com/book-a-stand): Exhibitor registration and sponsorship opportunities for GITEX GLOBAL 2023.
